Very tasty pizza
Mar 2025 • Couples
We found this place by accident whilst looking for somewhere to eat. We ate at the 2c Nguyen Truang To location. With just a small seating area, a great menu catering for westerns who like Pizza, Pasta and Nachos. I had a vegetarian lovers pizza (medium size) and it was delicious. Good range of drinks, including a cider (the first I had in Vietnam). They understood English well and catered for vegetarians and gluten free diets.
